name: Rafael Costa
bio:
Rafael's passion for motorsport ignited during his childhood in São Paulo, watching Ayrton Senna dominate the Formula 1 circuit. He channeled this enthusiasm into a formal education, earning a degree in Mechanical Engineering with a specialization in quality assurance. His meticulous nature and unwavering commitment to excellence quickly made him a sought-after asset in the Brazilian racing scene. 

Before transitioning to a free agent role, Rafael spent several years honing his skills with a prominent Brazilian stock car team. He believes in a data-driven approach to quality control, meticulously analyzing every aspect of vehicle performance to identify and address potential weaknesses. He’s known for his relentless pursuit of perfection and unwavering dedication to ensuring his team consistently delivers top-tier results.

Rafael's unwavering commitment to precision and his ability to identify even the smallest flaws make him an invaluable asset. He's driven by a desire to push boundaries and elevate the standards of quality control within the motorsport industry.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight fade on the sides
physical.description: Rafael is of average height with a lean, athletic build.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down observations.
Insists on using metric measurements exclusively.
Has a lucky charm, a miniature Senna helmet, that he keeps on his desk.
